title: Style of illustrations – how is it being depicted?

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines
location.section: Style of illustrations – how is it being depicted?

slide_intent: Choose an illustration style that supports the message because rendering style can make the same subject feel approachable, obscure or unrelated to its place.
strategic_value: Clear, colorful and relaxed illustration can carry Helsinki’s stated character across diverse topics.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section compares preferred and less suitable styles, combines photography with illustration and shows accessible explanations of complex subjects.
practical_value: Assess clarity, palette and character together when briefing an illustrator.

content_islands.name: Relaxed style
content_islands.spec: Compare natural, relaxed treatments with less suitable alternatives.

content_islands.name: Color and character
content_islands.spec: Show colorful, imaginative examples and photo/illustration combinations.

content_islands.name: Accessible explanation
content_islands.spec: Finish with clear explanatory illustrations against an obscure example.

ingredient.name: Illustration style
ingredient.role: Make city subjects approachable and distinctive.
ingredient.application: Use a clear, strong, natural and relaxed style with the city palette; choose imaginative combinations that retain understandable meaning.
ingredient.scope: Source language distinguishes must-use palette from preferred/avoided style directions; these examples do not establish one mandatory rendering technique.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source links approachable, clear style to Helsinki’s sustainability and functionality.
reference_purposes.Application: The examples demonstrate preferred style choices and mixed photo/illustration treatments.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Illustrations must use the city palette; the text advises against classical, historical, rustic-romantic and overly abstract styles.
